initial_plan.can_answer_question: partly: the file has no miles-driven exposure, so it cannot measure deaths per mile; it can show motorist deaths per reported crash
initial_plan.metric: sum of reported motorist deaths divided by crash rows with a nonmissing motorist-death count, by calendar year
initial_plan.denominator: number of police-reported crash rows in the year with a nonmissing number_of_motorists_killed
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated 2013 through 2025; the numerator counts reported motorist deaths attached to those crashes
filters: retain rows with nonmissing number_of_motorists_killed for both numerator and denominator

data_check_and_decisions.source_schema_note: The actual parquet field is number_of_motorist_killed (singular), differing from number_of_motorists_killed in the supplied description; the actual field is used.
data_check_and_decisions.findings: The plan's candidate population has 2,132,218 rows. crash_date is missing for 0 candidate rows and the motorist-death count is missing for 0 candidate rows. Every year 2013-2025 is covered from January 1 through December 31. See check_1.csv for each year's candidate and usable crash-row counts.
data_check_and_decisions.meaning_and_decisions: No rows are dropped or counted differently for missing motorist-death counts. Use all candidate crash rows; yearly denominators are the usable crash-row counts in check_1.csv. No partial years need special handling. The schema name is corrected in the final plan.

final_plan.can_answer_question: partly: this dataset cannot measure risk per mile driven because it contains no miles-driven exposure; it can measure reported motorist deaths per police-reported crash
final_plan.metric: annual reported motorist deaths per 1,000 police-reported crashes = 1,000 × sum(number_of_motorist_killed) / count of crashes, by crash_date calendar year
final_plan.denominator: count of police-reported crash rows in that year; all 2,132,218 rows have a nonmissing number_of_motorist_killed value
final_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash records dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; numerator is the number of motorists reported killed in those crashes
filters: no missing outcome rows excluded; actual parquet field number_of_motorist_killed is used
final_plan.limitations: A crash-based ratio is not deaths per mile or individual motorist risk: miles driven, travel volume, and unreported crashes are not measured. Crash-row counts vary by year (see check_1.csv), affecting the denominator and comparability of a per-crash rate.
